rationale: A repeatedly reorients to stimuli and shifts activities in a connected way: engages with PERSON_ALPHA after TOUCH and CALL, with FOOD_TROUGH after OFFER_FOOD, with PLAY_BALL after PRESENT_OBJECT, and leans away during STARTLE, later resuming play and even reengaging after attention is withdrawn. B shows brief early initiative (switching to PLAY_BALL, reacting to AVERSIVE_BUZZER) but then lies down from t=35–95 and largely ignores OFFER_FOOD, PRESENT_OBJECT, STARTLE, and attention withdrawal. A’s timeline shows sustained, adaptive, and coherent activity; B’s does not.
